general: Receipts, miscellaneous expenses or an unclear title.
food: Meals, restaurants, takeaway, bakeries and desserts.
drinks: Other non-alcoholic drinks, juices and soft drinks; use Coffee & tea or Liquor when clear.
groceries: Groceries, produce, meat, fish, dairy and snacks.
utilities: Other utility bills; use Electricity, Heating & gas, Water or TV, phone & internet when clear.
transport: Other transport expenses when no specific vehicle, transit, taxi, fuel, parking or toll category fits.
transit: Buses, trains, metro and other public transport.
travel: Other trip and travel expenses; use Flights and Hotel when clear.
home: Other home and family expenses; use rent, mortgage, supplies, furniture, maintenance or childcare when clear.
shopping: Other shopping purchases; use Clothing, Electronics, Appliances or Personal care when clear.
education: Books, stationery, tuition, courses and school expenses.
entertainment: Other entertainment and leisure activities; use Movies, Music, Games or Sports when clear.
work: Office expenses, professional tools and work software.
pets: Pet food, care and veterinary expenses.
fees: Other financial and recurring fees; use Bank fees, Insurance, Taxes or Subscriptions when clear.
services: Other services, general repairs and delivery services; use Home maintenance, Cleaning, Laundry or Moving when clear.
waste: Refuse collection, rubbish disposal and recycling services.
coffee: Coffee, tea and cafe drinks; not alcoholic drinks.
alcohol: Beer, wine, spirits and other alcoholic drinks.
takeaway: Takeaway meals and food delivery, including delivery charges on the meal.
movies: Cinema tickets and movie rentals; not recurring streaming subscriptions.
music: Music purchases, instruments and concerts; not recurring subscriptions.
gaming: Video games, board games and gaming purchases.
sports: Sports matches, equipment and participation; use Fitness for gym and exercise.
electronics: Computers, phones and electronic devices; not household appliances.
furniture: Furniture such as beds, sofas, desks and chairs.
household: Household consumables, toiletries, kitchenware and cleaning products; not cleaning services.
maintenance: Home repairs, plumbing, electrical work and property maintenance; not vehicle repairs.
mortgage: Mortgage instalments and home loan payments; not rent or security deposits.
rent: Rent for a home, room or apartment; not mortgage or refundable deposits.
appliances: Household appliances such as fridges, washing machines and ovens.
beauty: Haircuts, salon, skincare, cosmetics and personal grooming services.
insurance: Insurance premiums for health, life, home, travel or vehicles.
taxes: Government taxes and tax payments; not bank fees or insurance.
cycling: Bicycle purchases, cycle hire, bike accessories and bicycle repairs.
car: Car purchases and general vehicle expenses; use specific fuel, rental, parking or repair choices when clear.
fuel: Petrol, diesel, vehicle charging and other vehicle fuel; not home heating gas.
hotel: Hotels, hostels, resorts and holiday accommodation.
parking: Vehicle parking charges and parking permits.
flights: Airline tickets, flight baggage and airline fees.
taxi: Taxis, cabs and rideshare trips such as Uber or Ola.
tolls: Road, bridge and motorway tolls, including FASTag.
carrental: Car and motor vehicle rental or hire; not taxis or bicycle hire.
carmaintenance: Motor vehicle repairs, servicing, tyres and maintenance; not home repairs.
cleaning: House cleaning services, housekeepers and maids; not cleaning supplies or laundry.
electricity: Electricity bills and power charges; not vehicle charging.
gas: Home heating, cooking gas, LPG cylinders and gas utility bills; not vehicle fuel.
connectivity: Broadband, internet, mobile, landline and cable or satellite TV bills.
water: Water supply bills and drinking water delivery.
laundry: Laundry, dry cleaning and ironing services.
subscriptions: Recurring memberships, streaming and personal app subscriptions; not utility bills, insurance or work software.
charity: Charitable donations, fundraising and religious giving; not personal gifts.
medicine: Medicines, prescriptions and pharmacy purchases; not doctor visits.
dental: Dentist appointments, dental treatment and dental care.
moving: Moving home, movers, packing and relocation services.
deposit: Refundable rental or property security deposits; not rent or mortgage.
bankfees: Bank account charges, card fees, transfer fees and ATM fees.
